annotations.title: Net salary: Turkey vs the Netherlands

description: Take-home pay of a job in Turkey (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many TRY, for the euro amounts. Default 38 (indicative).

home_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in Turkey, in TRY

incentive.description: Employer SGK incentive: 2 = 2 points (most sectors, 2026); 5 = 5 points (manufacturing); 0 = None. Default 2.

nl_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in the Netherlands, in euros, without holiday allowance

nl_holiday_allowance.description: The Dutch job pays 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

nl_thirty_percent_ruling.description: The 30% ruling applies in the Netherlands. Default false.

tax_year.description: Tax year. Offered: 2026 (final), 2025 (final). Default 2026. A year that is not listed is not available for this country.
